notes.text: ENT operation note. Indication for surgery: This 58-year-old gentleman has a longstanding right-sided chronic suppurative otitis media and a cholesteatoma of the right middle ear, confirmed on preoperative CT of the temporal bones. Procedure performed: Right modified radical mastoidectomy and tympanoplasty under general anaesthesia. Operative findings: Extensive attic cholesteatoma with erosion of the long process of the incus. Post-operative diagnosis: Cholesteatoma of the right middle ear with associated chronic otitis media.
